source_notes: Fallout 4 (Steam) publishes only a 'public' branch, so PICS only ever exposes the CURRENT manifest. Historical manifests below were recovered from downgrade guides written by the modding community, who need exact depot/manifest pairs because F4SE breaks on every binary update. Three community-canonical eras exist: 1.10.163 (pre-'next-gen', stable for ~7 years, F4SE 0.6.23), 1.10.984 (the 'next-gen update', released in two steps on 2024-04-25 as 1.10.980 then hotfixed 2024-05-13 to 1.10.984, F4SE 0.7.2), and 1.11.221 (current, post 'Anniversary Update'/Creations Menu update of 2025-11-10 plus follow-up patches, F4SE 0.7.8 per https://f4se.silverlock.org/ as of 2026-08). 1.11.221 is CURRENT and retrievable via PICS directly, so it is intentionally omitted here. 1.10.980 (the original next-gen build, distinct from its 1.10.984 hotfix) and 1.10.984's precise transient predecessor 1.11.137 ('Creations Menu'/Patch 1, 2025-11-10 to ~2025-11-21) were NOT separately recoverable: every downgrade guide found treats 980/984 as interchangeable (F4SE required no update between them) and none published depot manifests for 1.11.137 specifically, since it was superseded within about two weeks by 1.11.221 -- so no downgrade demand for it ever arose. 1.10.163's exact release date was not confirmed (multiple pre-next-gen point patches existed over 2016-2022; the modding community treats the whole pre-2024-04-25 state as one target and no guide dated the specific 1.10.163 build). depot 377161 = base game 'content_a', 377162 = exe, 377163 = 'content_b', 377164-377168/393881-393884/393891/393899 = per-language depots (377164=English), 435870/435871 = Automatron (base/English), 435880 = Wasteland Workshop, 435881/435882 = Far Harbor, 480630/480631 = Contraptions/Vault-Tec Workshop, 393885/393895 = Nuka-World depots, 435872-435878/435888/490650 = per-language DLC depots. Depot/manifest labels taken verbatim from the Steam Community guides that annotate each download_depot line.

depots.label: Nuka-World
depots.note: single source (steamcommunity guide 3604110005) listing it under 1.10.984; identical value to the 1.10.163 manifest for the same depot, so it is plausible this depot simply never changed rather than being a distinct 984-era manifest -- recorded as-is but not independently corroborated in the 984 context

versions.note: 1.10.984 was the game's version from 2024-05-13 until the 2025-11-10 Anniversary/Creations Menu update; base game depots (377161-377163) and Automatron-english/Wasteland-Workshop manifests agree exactly between a Steam Community downgrade guide (posted Nov 2025) and an independent games-journalism article (Sportskeeda, Nov 2025) written after the Anniversary update shipped. English-language and base-Automatron depots, and the Nuka-World depot, are single-sourced and flagged low individually.
versions.label: 1.10.984 - next-gen update 2 (F4SE 0.7.2, pre-Anniversary)

rejected.rejected-reason: Its two core depots disagree about Data/Fallout4 - Meshes.ba2, so the download cannot be planned: depot 377161 gives sha 909d3fe2.../1492597526 while depot 377163 gives sha 27ef717b.../1493340537. Depot 377163's file here is byte-identical to the one in 1.10.984, a LATER build, which is the tell: this gid belongs to a different build than the one it is filed under. The `public` and `1_10_984` entries both have their two core depots in agreement, so the disagreement is specific to this entry's provenance and not something Steam does. Verified live against Steam on 2026-08-17. Re-add once depot 377163's manifest gid for build 1.10.163 is re-sourced; the 377161 gid here looks right and is probably reusable.
rejected.note: Base game (377161-377164), Automatron (435870/435871), and Wasteland Workshop (435880) manifests independently corroborated by 4 separate sources (a GitHub script, two Steam Community guides by different authors, and a games-journalism article), all in exact agreement. Other DLC/language depots corroborated by at least 2 of these sources except where flagged low above.
